statement: The NDC reports annual surface temperature increased by about 0.14-0.19 degrees C per decade during 1979-2020, alongside fewer rainy days and longer dry spells.
compact_statement: The NDC reports annual surface temperature increased by about 0.14-0.19 degrees C per decade during 1979-2020, alongside fewer rainy days and longer dry spells.

source_refs.locator: PDF p. 11, observed temperature and rainfall trends

uncertainty: A national trend summarized in the NDC; it does not attribute individual impacts to the trend.

statement: The profile reports that the 2015/16 drought reduced crop production by about 30 percent, lowered Hawane Dam levels, and left some rural boreholes dry.
compact_statement: The profile reports that the 2015/16 drought reduced crop production by about 30 percent, lowered Hawane Dam levels, and left some rural boreholes dry.
uncertainty: The profile summarizes the cited drought event and does not provide a counterfactual estimate.

statement: The profile says women, children and other vulnerable groups were disproportionately affected by the 2015/16 drought.
compact_statement: The profile says women, children and other vulnerable groups were disproportionately affected by the 2015/16 drought.

source_refs.locator: PDF p. 1, drought impacts and affected groups

uncertainty: The short profile does not disaggregate the reported effects by group or provide a measurement method in this passage.

statement: The profile rates drought assessment and monitoring capacity as medium, while describing early-warning capacity as medium and noting gaps in comprehensive risk assessment and implementation coordination.
compact_statement: The profile rates drought assessment and monitoring capacity as medium, while describing early-warning capacity as medium and noting gaps in comprehensive risk assessment and implementation coordination.

source_refs.locator: PDF p. 1, drought risk-management capacity ratings

uncertainty: Ratings are the profile's qualitative framework assessment, not an independently measured service-performance score.

statement: The NDC labels its high-emissions pathway RCP8.5/SSP8.5 (SSP shorthand ambiguous); it projects up to 1.9 degrees C warming by the 2050s and 3-4 times more Highveld days above 33 degrees C by 2050.
compact_statement: The NDC labels its high-emissions pathway RCP8.5/SSP8.5 (SSP shorthand ambiguous); it projects up to 1.9 degrees C warming by the 2050s and 3-4 times more Highveld days above 33 degrees C by 2050.
scenario: RCP8.5/SSP8.5, as printed; SSP shorthand is ambiguous

source_refs.locator: PDF p. 12, projected temperature and hot-day changes

uncertainty: NDC's SSP8.5 shorthand is nonstandard; no SSP5-8.5 conversion is inferred. Projections are not predictions.

statement: The NDC sets a target to keep annual agricultural yield reductions from climate shocks below 15 percent by 2035.
compact_statement: The NDC sets a target to keep annual agricultural yield reductions from climate shocks below 15 percent by 2035.
uncertainty: This is a stated national target, not evidence that the target has been financed, implemented or achieved.
